input.title: BUG: addition of non-UTC DatetimeArray with large Timedelta returns None
input.body:
With tz-naive (or UTC), this works fine:
```python
>>> arr = pd.array([0, 86400], dtype="M8[s]")
>>> arr
<DatetimeArray>
['1970-01-01 00:00:00', '1970-01-02 00:00:00']
Length: 2, dtype: datetime64[s]
>>> arr + np.timedelta64(10**13, "s")
<DatetimeArray>
['318857-05-20 17:46:40', '318857-05-21 17:46:40']
Length: 2, dtype: datetime64[s]
```

But when the array has a non-UTC timezone, it just returns nothing (`None`):
```python
>>> arr = pd.array([0, 86400], dtype="M8[s, Europe/Brussels]")
>>> arr + np.timedelta64(10**13, "s")
>>> arr + pd.Timedelta(np.timedelta64(10**13, "s"))
```

This happens on main, and also on 3.0.5, but worked fine on 2.3. So this seems a regression compared to 2.x.
